commits.author: Julian Eggers
commits.message:
Modernize build, CI, publishing and test tooling (#130)

* Modernize build, CI, publishing and test tooling

Aligns the project with the avides/spring-rabbit modernization applied
to xpath-helper and spring-xom-unmarshaller: Java 21 baseline, a
dependencyManagement import of spring-boot-dependencies (same version
as avides/spring-rabbit: 3.5.16) so Spring versions no longer need to
be pinned explicitly, central-publishing-maven-plugin instead of the
now-defunct OSSRH/nexus-staging + github-release-plugin pipeline,
pinned GitHub Actions with SonarCloud analysis, and full JUnit 4 ->
JUnit 5 Jupiter test migration (dropping unused EasyMock/PowerMock,
@Before -> @BeforeEach, public modifiers removed).

Also replaces WriterAnalyzer's regex-based generic-type-name parsing
plus Class.forName lookup with the JDK's ParameterizedType reflection
API, which is both more robust (handles nested generics correctly)
and avoids the Class.forName overhead.

* Add missing trailing newlines

POSIX/git convention: text files should end with a newline.
